comment: Notes conformance timeline. Rest captures sit at least 0.5 s after the action that precedes them. push / done, then search (focus / type hasPrefix Meet / cancel), settings tab (toggle iCloud, segment 1 = Title), back to notes, delete alert, confirm-delete. Same file drives Tools/oracle2/confprobe (real UIKit) and `openhost --app Notes` (the port). This trial records the port half on Linux only.
